verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a passkey plugin, shown in its config example (`passkey()`), and its homepage lists passkeys and magic links among its built-in auth methods. A hands-on community report says the passkey plugin takes about 7 lines of server code. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the passkey/WebAuthn flow, evidence beyond a homepage mention for magic-link sign-in, and evidence of email OTP as a primary passwordless sign-in method (OTP appears only as a 2FA second factor).
